author: Lintuxer
tagline: Share files from your ZimaOS box with a link
description:
**CasaDrop** turns your ZimaOS box into a place you can send files to and
share files from, without handing anything to a cloud provider.

- Drag and drop upload, with a link and an optional QR code
- Browse the host folders you allow, and share a file or a whole folder
- Receive links, so other people can send files *to* you
- Optional password, expiry between one hour and 30 days, download limit
- Video and audio stream in the browser instead of downloading first
- Multiple users, optionally through OIDC single sign-on

Reachable over the LAN out of the box. Public access is a matter of
putting a tunnel or a reverse proxy in front of it.

tips.before_install:
**Port.** The app is published on 8086. Change it in the form below if
that port is taken; the container always listens on 8080 internally.

**Which folders can be shared.** Only the five read-only mounts are
reachable: Media, Documents, Downloads, Gallery, Backup. `/DATA/AppData`
is left out on purpose — it holds other apps' databases and secrets.
Add a folder by adding both the bind mount and the entry in
`SHARE_ALLOWED_PATHS`.

**First start needs a token from the log.** CasaDrop prints a one-time
setup token when it starts and shows it *nowhere else*:

```
docker logs casadrop | grep "SETUP TOKEN"
```

Open the tile, paste the token, and choose an administrator password.
Do that before the app is reachable from anywhere but your LAN.
